channel.title: Comments on: Insatiably Curious at 70?
channel.description: taoism, taoist thought, buddha, yoga, tai chi, shakuhachi

item.title: By: Carl
item.dc:creator: Carl
item.description: Well thanks, but truly, whatever wisdom you see comes from within you! It must, because only wisdom knows wisdom. Fortunately, there is a lot more wisdom out there than it seems at times. Granted, biology and misinterpretation often get it the way, but that just keeps us on our toes, right? ;-)

item.title: By: Michael A. Lewis

item.description: Thank you for this essay. I have seven more years before I reach 70. I hope I can pick up a modest bit of the wisdom you have so eloquently portrayed.
